items.name: GenericListArray
items.summary: An array of [variable length lists], similar to JSON arrays (e.g. `["A", "B", "C"]`). This struct specifically represents the [list layout]. Refer to [`GenericListViewArray`] for the [list-view layout].

methods.summary: Creates a [`GenericListArray`] from an iterator of primitive values # Example ``` # use arrow_array::ListArray; # use arrow_array::types::Int32Type;

methods.name: from_nested_iter
methods.signature: fn from_nested_iter(iter: I) -> Self where B: ArrayBuilder + Default + Extend>, P: IntoIterator>, I: IntoIterator>
methods.summary: Creates a [`GenericListArray`] from a nested iterator of values. This method works for any values type that has a corresponding builder that implements the `Extend` trait. That includes all numeric types, booleans, binary and string types…
